Proper-noun (Neh 12:5). English convention.

Proper-noun, 24th priestly division and signer of Nehemiah's seal (1Chr 24:18; Neh 10:9 [8]). English convention.
Verb of being-few / diminishing (Gen 27:44; Lev 25:16; Num 11:32; 33:54; 35:8; Ps 107:38-39; Pro 13:11; Ecc 12:3; Isa 21:17; Jer 10:24; 29:6; Eze 11:16-17; etc.). 22 occurrences. Hyphenated stative.

Substantive of maal; the trust-breaking act (Lev 5:15; 6:2 [5:21]; 26:40; Num 5:6,12,15,18,27; Deu 32:51; Jos 7:1; 22:22; 1Chr 9:1; 10:13; etc.). 28 occurrences. Hyphenated; the covenant-trust-breach as legal-cultic category.
